content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.F.Sc. or B.Sc. Zoology Experience: Experience in fish and fisheries-related field survey and marine fish taxonomy. Age limit: 21 to 45 years (on the date of the interview) Other conditions: Candidates must produce valid ID proof at the time of interview. Candidates having marks issued in the form of CGPA/OGPA must produce an approved conversion table/formula. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview. Desirable: Experience in fish and fisheries-related field survey and marine fish taxonomy

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMFRI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill out the bio-data in the prescribed format attached in the notification. Scan the filled bio-data along with scanned copies of original supporting documents. Send the documents to the email address [email protected] on or before 18.11.2026 at 5 pm.

content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by e-mail. All required documents must be compiled and submitted as a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Field Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (on the date of the interview).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20000 per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.F.Sc. or B.Sc. Zoology.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must produce valid ID proof at the time of interview. Candidates having marks issued in the form of CGPA/OGPA must produce an approved conversion table/formula. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications based on qualifications and experience. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on a contract basis for a maximum period of one year. Purely temporary up to the completion of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Vizhinjam.
